$Comment: The scaffolding on every small lot of the temple hub that no district claims: a fenced plot with an iron frame going up, a few courses of stone, crates and a sign at the way in saying something new opens there soon. It names no lot, so any district that claims a lot takes its place there. Its prefab is drawn by tools/rooms/build_hub.py; rebuild it there rather than editing the prefab. Floor is the hub's street block, which every district shares so the streets match.
